sonnet.problem: The story card calls Solomon 'the king who built the house of the LORD'. That hands the baker the answer to the fill-in-the-blank on card 8 ('the days of ___ son of David king of Israel'), and the choice is meant to be an informed guess, not a giveaway.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The card says 'this year they missed it'. The text (30:3) only says they were unable to keep the Passover at the regular time and gives no year, so 'this year' adds a time the passage doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.
